variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.body: The home world has changed the colony's charter. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Colonial charter amended
variants.body: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
